high_attraction_beacons.title: MCP_2026_07_28_SPEC_MIGRATION_AND_CONFORMANCE_MAINTENANCE
high_attraction_beacons.chinese_title: MCP 2026-07-28 规范迁移与一致性维护
observed_money_motion: A current Upwork Java SDK maintenance engagement pays $60-$90/hour for 3-6 months, has already hired one engineer, and explicitly states that the 2026-07-28 MCP update rewrote sessions and forced a major SDK version.
A current Procore-to-Claude MCP server build is posted at $1,500 fixed price.
Specialist studios now publish fixed migration/audit prices including $1,500-$2,500 migration sprints, EUR 950 audits and EUR 2,400 migration sprints.
high_attraction_beacons.structural_trigger: The official MCP 2026-07-28 specification is the largest revision since launch, introduces a stateless core and authorization changes, and requires explicit opt-in for existing TypeScript v2 code to speak the new revision.
high_attraction_beacons.early_category_signal: Multiple small specialist providers have only recently productized fixed-scope migration/audit offers; this proves category formation but also creates immediate supply-growth risk.
high_attraction_beacons.delivery_shape: A large part of discovery, conformance probing, deprecated-feature inventory, protocol negotiation tests and regression verification is machine-executable; code remediation can be decomposed into bounded capability units, but bespoke application-state/auth changes may still require senior engineering.
high_attraction_beacons.execution_created_asset: Versioned migration rules, conformance probes, failure signatures, SDK/framework compatibility mappings and regression fixtures can be reused across customers when they contain no customer code or secrets.
high_attraction_beacons.rights_boundary: Reusable rules and public protocol behavior are clean; customer source code, credentials, proprietary tool schemas and deployment details remain customer-private and must not become a cross-customer asset.
high_attraction_beacons.incumbent_preflight: No single mature control plane is proven to own migration across heterogeneous MCP servers, but official SDK migration guides, free scanners, open-source tooling and emerging studios can compress the paid layer quickly.

examined_formations.title: MCP_2026_07_28_SPEC_MIGRATION_AND_CONFORMANCE_MAINTENANCE
examined_formations.chinese_title: MCP 2026-07-28 规范迁移与一致性维护
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The official 2026-07-28 MCP revision created real migration work; current paid SDK-maintenance hiring explicitly cites the session rewrite, and new specialist studios publish fixed migration/audit offers. Retain only to test payer incidence, machine-first standardization, platform absorption and founder-free inbound; do not promote.

examined_formations.title: SHOPIFY_GEO_AI_SEARCH_VISIBILITY_SERVICES
examined_formations.chinese_title: Shopify GEO / AI 搜索可见性服务
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A $1,750 Shopify GEO job hired one specialist but attracted 50+ proposals; many current GEO jobs attract 20-50+ proposals and require ongoing content, authority and measurement judgment. Direct payment is real, sparse specialized supply is not.

examined_formations.title: EU_AI_ACT_GOVERNANCE_ASSESSMENT_AND_COMPLIANCE_PACK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 欧盟 AI 法案治理评估与合规包
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current $300 EU AI Act governance role requests an expert to translate law into assessment rules and explicitly identify where specialist/legal review is required. The paid need is real, but expert regulatory judgment remains core and compliance SaaS is already forming.

examined_formations.title: WEBSITE_ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT_AND_REMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 网站无障碍审计与修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: EqualWeb publishes fixed audits from $4,800 and states that certified manual review is required beyond automated remediation. This is strong willingness to pay but a mature expert-led service rather than a founder-independent machine/delegation edge.

examined_formations.title: AGENTIC_COMMERCE_PRODUCT_FEED_AND_AI_CHANNEL_ENABLEMENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: Agentic Commerce 商品源与 AI 渠道接入
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Agentic commerce is early and monetized, but Shopify now offers a no-monthly-fee Agentic plan that structures and syndicates products to major AI channels and manages agentic storefronts centrally. The core connection loop is being platformized.

examined_formations.title: GENERIC_N8N_AI_WORKFLOW_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 通用 n8n AI 工作流自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current n8n/AI workflow jobs pay from tens of dollars to $1,000+ and some productized offers charge thousands, but live jobs commonly show 10-50+ proposals and require customer-specific integrations, credentials, debugging and ongoing maintenance. Payment is proven; sparse supply and compounding operator control are not.
